notes: v8.1 (2026-08-25) — SHARED NOTES SYNC (WSTX). Approvals and notes write straight to a private repo on click instead of living in one browser's localStorage until someone clicks 'Save notes file'. Same pattern the Profit Planner proved in production (its skill §9): one shared state file, optimistic concurrency — 409/422 re-pulls, re-merges the queued ops and pushes again, 3 attempts. Notes layer is now THREE tiers (BAKED < REM < LSN) resolved newest-wins by a new `ts` field; `ts` is merge metadata only, note/by/at/approved and EVERY key format are unchanged, so no saved note is orphaned and every export is byte-identical. setNote stamps ts = max(now, prev.ts+1) so an explicit edit always supersedes what it edited — a fast clock cannot outvote a later correction. New sync-state chip in the explain-&-approve toolbar (Local only / Synced / Sync failed) because token expiry is the documented silent failure mode. CFG is spliced at PUBLISH time, never at freeze time: this frozen template carries CFG=null, so the token exists only inside the published StatiCrypt payload and rotating it is a skill edit, not a template revision. WITH CFG NULL THE ENGINE IS BEHAVIOURALLY IDENTICAL TO v8.0 — zero network calls, localStorage store, same reads/writes (verified 7/7). Sync suite verified 14/14: queue, debounced push, first-write 404 create, two forced 409 collisions retried to success with a concurrent writer's key preserved and prior keys intact, newest-wins precedence both directions. build_data.py UNCHANGED (4740e318…). NOT YET VERIFIED ON REAL DATA — this session had no SharePoint mount, so the §4 headless render on live inputs has not run; the nightly's own §4 gate must pass before this is trusted.
